additional_blockers.reason: The seven R9-REG-022 variants use legacy fixture IDs such as renamed_reordered_resolved and stale_vs_current, while the seven top-level counterfactuals use R9-SEM-REG-007 through R9-SEM-REG-013 and projection_q7 through projection_leakage_scan_p9. No frozen source-native crosswalk binds them. Separate execution duplicates proof; receipt reuse without a crosswalk invents authority.

Several source rows name symbolic strategies or private evaluator behavior rather than an exact public invocation: coverage_meta, evidence_mutation tamper tokens, source_binding_projection, and _evaluate_provider_projection. The authorized artifacts do not bind each such row to an exact public CLI command, cwd, environment, inputs, mutation bytes, and expected return/capture.

Process evidence overlaps multiple regression variants. HARD_LOSS_AFTER_REQUEST overlaps hard-loss-after-request and incomplete-fuse-after-request; RAW_PREFIX_REOPEN_INVALID overlaps raw-prefix-reopen-invalid and loss-after-raw; COMPLETION_PREFIX_REOPEN_INVALID overlaps completion-prefix-reopen-invalid and loss-after-completion. No frozen primary-receipt and alias mapping prevents duplicated proof from being reported as independent experiments.

A complete actual tree inventory does not itself close the oracle. Several process rows specify counts or partial prefixes rather than a complete expected path, entry-type, byte, and metadata-policy set. Unless exact expected-versus-observed leaf-set equality is predeclared, unexpected facts can still be ignored after capture.

Receipts and inventories are proposed inside the unique case directory, but an inventory cannot hash itself or files created after its snapshot. The subject-output root and worker-receipt root require distinct boundaries, followed by an independent post-worker inventory of the entire case root.

The build contract separately requires four capture tests and three known-family tests, in addition to clean and relocation requirements. The six exact namespaces do not demonstrate a bijection to those prose leaves. Clean and relocation rows alone are insufficient.

Internal-cycle-014 still prescribes a total schema-driven compiler, while the later monolithic-family rejection forbids further execution of that family. The replacement manifest must explicitly mark the earlier next_action as superseded historical evidence.

SAME_ROOT_REINVOKE_ZERO_REQUEST declares expected_second_process.error as the opaque literal x. Before whole-row comparison, an exact binding must state whether x is a literal runtime oracle or a placeholder; inference is not admissible.

coverage_accounting_model.derived_rule: Coverage-meta and family results are derived nodes with exact prerequisite sets; they never count as independent execution proof.
coverage_accounting_model.failure_rule: The first attempt is retained; retry_count, replacement_count, best_of_count, and automatic relaunch must all remain zero.
coverage_accounting_model.final_rule: Independent aggregators reopen raw captures and trees, not merely worker verdicts. Final xhigh independently reopens every primary receipt, alias binding, derived dependency set, and prose-origin row.
coverage_accounting_model.process_rule: Each process receipt binds the complete predecessor fault row, the corresponding current-component binding row, and the current four-part identity. Predecessor execution evidence receives no current-byte credit.
coverage_accounting_model.proof_rule: Each obligation has exactly one primary receipt. Cross-namespace or same-namespace reuse requires a frozen alias edge, and every aliased expectation is independently evaluated against the same raw receipt. Coverage counts and independent-execution counts are reported separately.
coverage_accounting_model.set_rule: For each namespace, declared IDs must equal source-ledger IDs and receipt-bound IDs exactly; missing, extra, duplicate, or multiply-primary IDs fail.
coverage_accounting_model.tree_rule: Exact path-sorted full-leaf equality is required. No expected-key projection, catch-all path, silent exclusion, or unexpected-entry tolerance is permitted.

first_blocker.blocking_effect: Exact 22/56/10/9/18/7 set equality cannot establish complete executable coverage.
first_blocker.reason: This member of the exact 56-variant set is not independently executable and does not enumerate the receipts on which its result depends. A case worker can only self-attest true, while an aggregator must invent the dependency mapping. Either path smuggles shared oracle authority and can repeat the historical incomplete-recovery-suite failure.

required_minimal_corrections: Predeclare a data-only obligation manifest whose every entry binds namespace, ID, RFC6901 source pointer, canonical source-row sha256 and bytes, origin class, current component identity, exact execution recipe, and exact expected closed-world result.

For R9-REG-011, add a derived CONTROLLER_DECLARED_FROM_PROSE row containing the exact prerequisite ID set. It must be computed only from reopened primary receipts and must not be represented as an independently executed source-native case.

Freeze explicit crosswalks for all overlapping obligations, including the seven R9-REG-022-to-counterfactual mappings and process-fault-to-regression mappings. One primary execution may satisfy multiple obligations only through these predeclared mappings.

Bind every symbolic mutation or evaluator row to an exact local operation or documented existing public CLI path. Any controller-authored operation must bind the exact source string and remain labeled CONTROLLER_DECLARED_FROM_PROSE or CONTROLLER_OPERATIONAL_BINDING, never SOURCE_NATIVE.
For every case, predeclare the exact allowed relative-path and entry-type set plus file-byte or explicitly typed dynamic-field expectations. Unknown actual or expected leaves must fail.
Separate subject_root from worker_receipts. Inventory subject_root after quiescence; after the worker exits, have an independent aggregator inventory and reopen the complete case root.
Create or freeze mappings for every build-contract capture, known-family, clean, relocation, reopen, migration, static-check, and quiescence leaf. Unmapped prose leaves fail closed.
Explicitly supersede the cycle-014 total-compiler next action with the later monolithic-harness rejection.
Resolve the SAME_ROOT error literal before execution.
Re-run this architecture falsification before any case execution.
